Will researchers travel during the PhD?

The program involves mobility across participating institutions and partners.

Is there an MSCA mobility requirement?

Yes. PhD researchers recruited through the project must satisfy the relevant MSCA mobility requirements, including the stated restriction concerning residence and employment in the country of the enrolling institution.

Who are the research partners?

The network includes organizations such as Action on Armed Violence, CIDOB, Clingendael, Fondazione Giangiacomo Feltrinelli, ICIP, International IDEA, and the Political Institutions and Conflict – Max Planck Institute.

Conclusion

The DIViNE Doctoral Network presents a multidisciplinary PhD research opportunity for researchers interested in the complex relationship between democratic institutions and political violence.

By bringing together five major European university research environments and several international research and policy partners, the network seeks to investigate why political violence persists, how it changes, and how democratic institutions and societies respond to violent pressures.

The research agenda covers historical legacies of violence, democratization and conflict resolution, public support for violent movements, institutional reform, militarization, democratic decline, repression, and democratic resilience.The network also places strong emphasis on methodological diversity, combining quantitative research, behavioral and experimental approaches, historical and archival inquiry, institutional and normative theory, and policy engagement.For prospective doctoral researchers, the immediate opportunity is to submit an Expression of Interest by October 10, 2026. The formal PhD vacancy announcements are expected between October and November 2026, with positions expected to begin by January 2027.Candidates interested in participating should prepare a focused research idea, identify the DIViNE research theme that best fits their interests, review the MSCA mobility requirements, and arrange two appropriate academic referees before submitting their expression of interest.

item.content:encoded:
Google offers a range of scholarship opportunities designed to support students pursuing education and careers in computer science, technology, and related fields.

These scholarships are aimed at supporting students from different backgrounds, including underrepresented students in technology, women in technology, students with disabilities, student veterans, and students from specific countries or regions.

Through its scholarship programmes and partnerships with organisations such as Lime Connect, Student Veterans of America, and EmployAbility, Google provides financial support and opportunities designed to help students continue their education, develop their skills, and contribute to the technology sector.

The available opportunities vary in terms of eligibility, location, academic requirements, and target groups. Some are designed for students in the United States and Canada, while others focus on Europe or India. There are also opportunities intended for specific groups that have traditionally been underrepresented in technology.

This article provides an overview of the Google scholarship opportunities listed, including their purpose, target applicants, geographical focus, and what prospective applicants should know before applying.

Overview of Google Scholarship Opportunities

The scholarship opportunities covered include:

  1. Generation Google Scholarship
  2. Google Anita Borg Memorial Scholarship
  3. Google Europe Scholarship for Students with Disabilities
  4. Google Lime Scholarship
  5. Google SVA Scholarship
  6. Google Travel and Conference Grants
  7. Venkat Panchapakesan Memorial Scholarship

Each programme has a different focus, so students should carefully review the requirements of the individual scholarship before applying.

1. Generation Google Scholarship

The Generation Google Scholarship was established to encourage students from underrepresented backgrounds in computer science to excel academically and develop into future leaders in the technology field.

The programme is designed around the idea that increasing representation in computer science can help create a more diverse technology industry.

Students who receive this scholarship are supported in their academic journey while being encouraged to become active role models and leaders within their communities and professional fields.

Purpose of the Generation Google Scholarship

The scholarship aims to support students who are pursuing studies related to computer science and who belong to groups that are underrepresented in the field.

The programme places emphasis on:

  • Academic excellence
  • Computer science education
  • Leadership development
  • Representation in technology
  • Encouraging students to become role models
  • Supporting future technology professionals

Students interested in the programme should review the official scholarship information to determine the current eligibility requirements and application process.

2. Google Anita Borg Memorial Scholarship

The Google Anita Borg Memorial Scholarship was created in honour of Anita Borg, a prominent advocate for women in technology.

The scholarship is designed to encourage women to excel in technology-related fields and become active leaders and role models within the technology industry.

The programme reflects the goal of increasing the participation and representation of women in technology.

Purpose of the Scholarship

The scholarship supports women pursuing studies and careers in technology and encourages recipients to develop their leadership capabilities.

The opportunity can be particularly relevant to students who are passionate about technology and want to contribute to the future development of the sector.

Key areas associated with the scholarship include:

  • Women in technology
  • Computer science
  • Academic excellence
  • Leadership
  • Professional development
  • Representation in the technology industry

Prospective applicants should consult the official scholarship information for the current programme requirements.

3. Google Europe Scholarship for Students with Disabilities

The Google Europe Scholarship for Students with Disabilities supports students with disabilities who are pursuing computer science-related education in Europe.

Google offers the programme through its partnership with EmployAbility.

The scholarship considers several areas when assessing applicants, including their academic background, leadership skills, and demonstrated passion for computer science.

Who Is the Scholarship Designed For?

The programme is intended for students with disabilities who are pursuing university-level education in computer science or a related field in Europe.

Applicants are expected to demonstrate qualities such as:

  • A strong academic background
  • Leadership potential
  • Passion for computer science
  • Commitment to their studies
  • Interest in developing a career in technology

The scholarship is particularly relevant to students who want to build careers in computer science while contributing to greater representation and inclusion within the technology sector.

4. Google Lime Scholarship

The Google Lime Scholarship is offered through Google’s partnership with Lime Connect.

The programme supports students with disabilities who are pursuing university degrees in computer science in the United States and Canada.

Lime Connect works to support students and professionals with disabilities in pursuing educational and career opportunities.

Focus of the Google Lime Scholarship

The scholarship is focused on students who:

  • Have a disability
  • Are pursuing a university degree
  • Are studying computer science
  • Are studying in the United States or Canada

The programme provides support to students as they work toward completing their education and preparing for careers in technology.

Students interested in this opportunity should review the current requirements through Lime Connect before applying.

5. Google SVA Scholarship

The Google SVA Scholarship is provided through Google’s partnership with Student Veterans of America (SVA).

The scholarship is designed to assist student veterans who are pursuing university degrees in computer science in the United States.

This opportunity recognises the educational goals of veterans who are transitioning into or developing careers in technology.

Who Can Benefit From the Google SVA Scholarship?

The programme is designed for student veterans who are pursuing university education in computer science.

The scholarship is particularly relevant to applicants who:

  • Are student veterans
  • Are pursuing a university degree
  • Are studying computer science
  • Are based in the United States

By supporting student veterans studying computer science, the programme provides an opportunity for recipients to continue their education and develop skills that can be applied to careers in the technology industry.

6. Google Travel and Conference Grants

Google also offers Travel and Conference Grants for selected conferences in computer science and related fields in North America.

Unlike the scholarships that primarily support university education, these grants are designed to help eligible individuals participate in relevant conferences.

Participation in academic and professional conferences can provide students and technology professionals with opportunities to learn about developments in their field, meet other professionals, share ideas, and expand their professional networks.

Who Are the Travel and Conference Grants For?

The programme states that grants are available for traditionally underrepresented groups in technology.

The opportunity therefore focuses on improving access to selected computer science and technology conferences for individuals who may otherwise face barriers to participation.

The grants may support participation in selected conferences in North America, subject to the specific requirements of each conference and grant programme.

Applicants should review the official information for details about eligible conferences and current application requirements.

7. Venkat Panchapakesan Memorial Scholarship

The Venkat Panchapakesan Memorial Scholarship was established in honour of Venkat Panchapakesan.

The scholarship is designed for students in India who are passionate about computer science and want to use technology to contribute to a more sustainable world.

The programme encourages students who combine an interest in computer science with a desire to create positive environmental and social change.

Focus of the Venkat Panchapakesan Memorial Scholarship

The scholarship looks for students who demonstrate qualities such as:

  • Passion for computer science
  • Optimism
  • Commitment to education
  • Interest in sustainability
  • Desire to use technology to address global challenges

The opportunity can be particularly relevant to students who want to combine technology with sustainability and use their future careers to contribute to solutions for environmental and societal challenges.

APPLY HERE

Why Google Offers Scholarship Opportunities

Scholarships can play an important role in helping students access and complete higher education.

Google’s scholarship programmes focus on several areas of diversity, representation, academic development, and technology education.

Across the opportunities listed, several common themes can be identified.

Supporting Underrepresented Students

Some of Google’s programmes specifically focus on students from groups that have historically been underrepresented in technology.

These include programmes supporting women in technology, students with disabilities, and other traditionally underrepresented groups.

Encouraging Computer Science Education

Many of the scholarships are specifically connected to computer science.

This reflects the importance of developing students who can contribute to the technology sector through education, research, innovation, and professional careers.

Developing Future Leaders

Several of the programmes emphasise leadership and encourage recipients to become role models within their communities and professional fields.

This means that applicants may need to demonstrate more than academic ability. Leadership experience, community involvement, passion, and long-term goals can also be relevant depending on the programme.

Promoting Diversity in Technology

Another major theme across the scholarship opportunities is increasing diversity within technology.

By supporting students from different backgrounds and communities, these programmes seek to create greater opportunities for people who may otherwise face barriers to entering technology-related fields.

Which Google Scholarship Is Right for You?

Because the scholarships have different eligibility requirements, students should first determine which programme matches their circumstances.

If you are an underrepresented student in computer science

The Generation Google Scholarship may be relevant to you.

If you are a woman pursuing technology

The Google Anita Borg Memorial Scholarship focuses specifically on supporting women in technology.

If you are a student with a disability in Europe

The Google Europe Scholarship for Students with Disabilities may be relevant.

If you are a student with a disability in the United States or Canada

The Google Lime Scholarship is designed for students with disabilities pursuing computer science degrees in those countries.

If you are a student veteran in the United States

The Google SVA Scholarship is specifically designed for student veterans pursuing university degrees in computer science.

If you belong to a traditionally underrepresented group in technology

The Google Travel and Conference Grants may provide opportunities to attend selected computer science and related conferences in North America.

If you are a student in India interested in computer science and sustainability

The Venkat Panchapakesan Memorial Scholarship may be relevant to your educational and career goals.

Important Things Applicants Should Consider

Before applying for any Google scholarship, prospective applicants should carefully review the requirements for the specific programme.

Important factors may include:

  • Academic programme
  • Field of study
  • University or educational institution
  • Country or region
  • Disability status where applicable
  • Gender eligibility where applicable
  • Veteran status where applicable
  • Academic performance
  • Leadership experience
  • Career interests
  • Demonstrated passion for computer science
  • Application documents
  • Application period

Eligibility can differ significantly between programmes, so students should not assume that meeting the requirements for one scholarship automatically means they qualify for another.

Visit HERE to learn more about the Google Scholarships 2026

Application Deadlines

The information provided for these scholarship opportunities does not include specific application deadlines.

Students should therefore visit the official scholarship pages linked to each programme to check whether applications are currently open and to confirm the latest deadlines, eligibility requirements, and application instructions.

Because scholarship cycles can change from year to year, applicants should always rely on the current information provided by the relevant programme.

How to Prepare for a Google Scholarship Application

Students interested in these opportunities can begin preparing before applications open.

1. Maintain Strong Academic Performance

Several of the programmes place importance on academic background and excellence.

Students should maintain strong academic records and keep documentation of their educational achievements.

2. Develop Leadership Experience

Leadership is an important theme across several of the programmes.

Students can develop leadership experience through:

  • Student organisations
  • Community projects
  • Technology initiatives
  • Volunteer activities
  • Academic projects
  • Mentoring
  • Professional or extracurricular activities

3. Demonstrate Your Passion for Technology

Applicants should be able to clearly explain their interest in computer science and technology.

This could include projects, coursework, research, internships, competitions, community activities, or other experiences related to technology.

4. Explain Your Long-Term Goals

Applicants should be prepared to explain how their education connects to their future plans.

A strong application can clearly communicate what the applicant hopes to accomplish through their education and how their interests connect to the technology sector.

5. Research the Specific Scholarship

The most important step is to review the requirements of the specific scholarship you intend to apply for.

Different Google programmes have different target groups and geographical requirements.

Conclusion

Google offers a diverse collection of scholarship and grant opportunities designed to support students and individuals pursuing education and professional development in computer science, technology, and related fields.

The opportunities include the Generation Google Scholarship, Google Anita Borg Memorial Scholarship, Google Europe Scholarship for Students with Disabilities, Google Lime Scholarship, Google SVA Scholarship, Google Travel and Conference Grants, and the Venkat Panchapakesan Memorial Scholarship.

While some programmes support underrepresented students in technology generally, others are specifically designed for women, students with disabilities, student veterans, or students in particular countries and regions.

The geographical scope also varies. Some programmes focus on Europe, others on the United States and Canada, while the Venkat Panchapakesan Memorial Scholarship is focused on students in India.

Students interested in these opportunities should carefully review the individual programme requirements and current application information before applying. Since deadlines and eligibility conditions can change between scholarship cycles, applicants should use the official programme pages to confirm the latest information.

For students passionate about computer science and technology, these opportunities can provide valuable support while helping them pursue their education, develop leadership skills, and prepare for future careers in the technology sector.

For more global grants, scholarships, fellowships, internships, jobs, conferences, competitions, and other career opportunities for young people, visit the Opportunities for Youth (OFY) website at www.opportunitiesforyouth.org.
